properties.description:
crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_degraded_server_recovers_when_its_cause_clears.rs, six real-binary tests, run by `cargo test --workspace` in CI:
- HTTP: server B started on a store server A holds answers /readyz 503 with a path-free reason and /healthz 200, and serves the one tool. After A stops, the SAME process and port serve the design and /readyz goes 200.
- HTTP, served for others (--http-allow-host team.example.org): after the wait, the handshake says SERVED FOR OTHERS, a settle is refused naming --http-trusted-gateway, and the operator banner says how signatures are held — the caller rule of #616 fix 4 holds on the recovery door as on the startup door.
- stdio: the degraded handshake declares tools.listChanged; when the holder stops the client is told notifications/tools/list_changed and sees the full list.
- --shared: a session whose election timed out re-elects and serves the design in place.
- /readyz and /healthz answer any Host; the design stays behind the Host gate; a registry is ready when up.
- a broken stamp is not polled and readiness stays 503.
properties.findings:
OBSERVED FAILING FIRST on unfixed main (329a074), 2026-09-28: 5 of 5 failed. /readyz answered rmcp's "400 Bad Request: Session ID is required" (three tests); the degraded stdio handshake declared no tools.listChanged; the --shared session was never told its tool list changed within 120 s of the holder stopping.
OBSERVED FAILING FIRST on the merge of main into #620 without the fix, 2026-09-30: the sixth test failed — the recovered design came up LOCAL, with no SERVED FOR OTHERS in its handshake. Passing with chg:a-design-served-after-a-held-lock-frees-is-prepared-the-way-a-healthy-start-prepares-it (6 of 6).
properties.name: A server behind a held store serves it in place when it frees, and /readyz says whether the design is served
